GeneDef.label: harbinger tree ability
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have been implanted with harbinger tree genes. Like harbinger trees in human form, they can consume corpses and produce bioferrite. They withstand the stench of corpses just as harbinger trees do, and produce large quantities of twisted meat and bioferrite upon death.

customEffectDescriptions.li: While food need remains at or above 50%, produces 20 bioferrite per day.
When butchered, produces twisted meat, dread leather, and bioferrite instead of human meat and human leather.

GeneDef.label: carrion feeding
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene can eat only raw meat and corpses, the same food consumed by harbinger trees. In return, corpses provide them with exceptionally large amounts of nutrition, and eating corpses causes no mood penalty.

customEffectDescriptions.li: Can eat only raw meat and corpses.
Nutrition from raw meat ×300%.
Nutrition from corpses ×500%.
No negative mood effects from eating raw food or corpses.

GeneDef.label: slow eating
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene eat very slowly.\n\n...You cannot expect a harbinger tree to consume corpses quickly.

GeneDef.label: hunger dormancy
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene do not die of starvation. Malnutrition causes them to enter dormancy, and sufficient nutrition awakens them. However, moderate malnutrition renders them unconscious.\n\nHarbinger trees do not die when deprived of nutrition either.

customEffectDescriptions.li: Immediately enters hunger dormancy and loses consciousness upon reaching moderate malnutrition.
Wakes from hunger dormancy when food need recovers to at least 30%.
Can still be fed during dormancy unless the carrier also has the "cannot eat" gene.
Cannot die from malnutrition; its severity stops increasing once it reaches extreme.

GeneDef.label: humanlike entity
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene are regarded as entities. Other entities do not actively attack carriers, but carriers suffer a mood penalty when they kill an entity.

customEffectDescriptions.li: Entities will not actively target the carrier unless the carrier attacks them first.
Other people have a lower opinion of the carrier as an entity.
Witnessing an entity's death or killing an entity lowers mood.

GeneDef.label: nutrition-induced conception
GeneDef.description: Female carriers of this gene become parthenogenetically pregnant when extremely well nourished, just as a well-fed harbinger tree produces new saplings. Strangely, ordinary intimate relations can also make a carrier pregnant.

customEffectDescriptions.li: Female carriers with food need at or above 90% have a 2% chance per day to become pregnant through parthenogenesis.

GeneDef.label: dark scholar
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have an innate understanding of anomaly-related science. They are born to investigate the occult, and the psychic rituals they perform are more likely to succeed.

GeneDef.label: occult faith
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene are deeply devoted to the Horax cult. They believe in no technology other than anomaly technology and refuse to do anything that looks "scientific." They clearly do not realize that Horax is itself a mechanical archotech intelligence.

customEffectDescriptions.li: Cannot perform work: research, hacking.

GeneDef.label: harbinger tree hair
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have a specific hair color. If multiple hair-color genes are present, one is chosen at random.

customEffectDescriptions.li: Changes hair color to the color of a harbinger tree.

GeneDef.label: flesh flower
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene bloom more and more as their stomachs fill, just like harbinger trees.

customEffectDescriptions.li: Displays harbinger tree flowers on the head in three stages: sparse below 30% food need, normal from 30% to 80%, and abundant at or above 80%.

GeneDef.label: harbinger tree affinity
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene share a special connection with harbinger trees that amplifies the trees' unusual abilities. Like harbinger trees, they withstand the stench of corpses and can summon a harbinger tree sprout once per quadrum. They also expand the trees' corpse-consumption radius and share their level of satiation.

customEffectDescriptions.li: When butchered, produces twisted meat, dread leather, and bioferrite instead of human meat and human leather.
Each active carrier on the map increases the corpse-consumption radius of harbinger trees by 2.
Having harbinger trees in the colony increases mood; their absence lowers mood.
Can use an ability to summon a harbinger tree.
Can draw nutrition from harbinger trees.

GeneDef.label: cannot eat
GeneDef.description:
Carriers of this gene cannot eat any normal food. If they also have the harbinger tree affinity gene, they can fill their stomachs by drawing nutrition from a harbinger tree.
Warning: Adding this gene to a colonist without the harbinger tree affinity gene is not recommended.

customEffectDescriptions.li: Cannot eat any food.

GeneDef.label: carrionkin aversion
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene were created as part of a plan to counter the carrionkin, and therefore harbor an intense dislike of them.

customEffectDescriptions.li: Opinion of carrionkin: -60.
Having carrionkin in the colony gives -5 mood.

GeneDef.label: branch claws
GeneDef.description: The hands of carriers of this gene can pierce others like the sharp branches of a harbinger tree, while retaining the ability to perform delicate work. Carriers can use these sharp branches to pulverize corpses into meat mush for harbinger trees to absorb.

customEffectDescriptions.li: "Pulverize corpse" turns corpses into meat mush; 1-second warmup and 5-second cooldown.
